purpose: every population this project states in a tracked record, with the expected, examined and omitted counts, whether omitted members are recorded, and the record and locator that state each number

CA_REFUSED_ABSENT_AS_EMPTY.condition: an absent record or input is read as a population of zero
CA_REFUSED_ABSENT_AS_EMPTY.prevents: that a missing observation is an observation of nothing, so a tool that did not run is read as a tool that found no defect

CA_REFUSED_ABSENT_AS_OBSERVED.condition: an absent population is presented as complete, sampled or otherwise observed
CA_REFUSED_ABSENT_AS_OBSERVED.prevents: that members were examined when the record that would name them is not present

CA_REFUSED_COUNT_INCONSISTENT.condition: examined plus omitted does not equal expected, or examined exceeds expected
CA_REFUSED_COUNT_INCONSISTENT.prevents: that the stated parts account for the whole, when they do not add up

CA_REFUSED_DUPLICATE_MEMBER.condition: a census counts the same member twice
CA_REFUSED_DUPLICATE_MEMBER.prevents: that a population of N distinct members was examined, when fewer were

CA_REFUSED_EMPTY_AS_ABSENT.condition: a population that was examined and is empty is recorded as an absent one
CA_REFUSED_EMPTY_AS_ABSENT.prevents: that the examination did not happen, which discards a real zero result and makes an empty population indistinguishable from a missing one

CA_REFUSED_EXIT_AS_COMPLETENESS.condition: a process exit status is used as a population or as proof that everything was examined
CA_REFUSED_EXIT_AS_COMPLETENESS.prevents: that a zero exit means nothing was skipped; a harness that exits zero after skipping, truncating or stopping early is read as a complete run

CA_REFUSED_MEMBER_UNIDENTIFIED.condition: a count is stated but the examined members are not identified
CA_REFUSED_MEMBER_UNIDENTIFIED.prevents: that the count can be audited: a member with no identity cannot be re-read, deduplicated or checked, so the count is an assertion

CA_REFUSED_OMITTED_UNRECORDED.condition: members are omitted and the omission is neither identified nor bounded
CA_REFUSED_OMITTED_UNRECORDED.prevents: that a total stands for the members, so an aggregate cannot be reviewed and the unexamined remainder cannot even be counted

CA_REFUSED_POPULATION_DRIFT.condition: two records state different populations for the same subject, or the live record no longer matches the declaration it produced
CA_REFUSED_POPULATION_DRIFT.prevents: that a count read at one identity applies at another; an admission outliving the bytes it read is an unverified claim

CA_REFUSED_SAMPLE_AS_CENSUS.condition: a declared sample is presented as a census
CA_REFUSED_SAMPLE_AS_CENSUS.prevents: that the unexamined remainder shares the sample's property; a sample licenses a statement about the sample only

CA_REFUSED_SAMPLE_WITHOUT_POPULATION.condition: a sample reports its examined count before any record states its expected population
CA_REFUSED_SAMPLE_WITHOUT_POPULATION.prevents: that the examined count is a fraction of something known; a numerator without a denominator is not a sample

CA_REFUSED_STATE_CONTRADICTED.condition: the declared state is contradicted by the recorded facts and no more specific code applies
CA_REFUSED_STATE_CONTRADICTED.prevents: that a declaration is its own evidence

CA_REFUSED_STATE_UNDECLARED.condition: a population declaration names no admission state
CA_REFUSED_STATE_UNDECLARED.prevents: that the state can be inferred from the count, when the count is exactly what is in question

CA_REFUSED_TRUNCATION_AS_COMPLETE.condition: an enumeration stopped at a bound is presented as a census
CA_REFUSED_TRUNCATION_AS_COMPLETE.prevents: that every member was examined, when the record's own bound says how many were not

CA_REFUSED_UNKNOWN_AS_COMPLETE.condition: a population whose extent is unknown is presented as complete
CA_REFUSED_UNKNOWN_AS_COMPLETE.prevents: that an unbounded observation is a bounded one, so a result cannot be falsified by a member it never looked for

CA_REFUSED_UNRECORDED_POPULATION.condition: no record states the expected population, so a completeness claim has no denominator
CA_REFUSED_UNRECORDED_POPULATION.prevents: that a count is a census because no other number was offered; a total without a population cannot say what is missing

ABSENT.doesNotLicense: an empty population: absence is a missing observation, not an observation of zero
ABSENT.licenses: the record or the named input is not present, so nothing was examined and no member count follows

AGGREGATE_ONLY.doesNotLicense: a census or a sample: a number with no member row is not an examined population
AGGREGATE_ONLY.licenses: a total is stated without the identity of the members, so the count can be quoted and nothing can be reviewed or re-run from it

COMPLETE.doesNotLicense: nothing about the tree the population was drawn from; a complete record-set is not a complete tree, and completeness is not correctness
COMPLETE.licenses: every member of the declared population is present and identified, the expected count is stated by a record, examined equals it, and nothing is omitted

DEFERRED.doesNotLicense: any result: a named not-run analysis is a declaration of a gap, never evidence of the property it would have measured
DEFERRED.licenses: nothing was examined and every omitted member is named, so the gap is known exactly and is not an absence

EMPTY.doesNotLicense: an absent population: zero examined is a result only when a record says the expected population is zero
EMPTY.licenses: the record is present and states that the population has zero members

SAMPLED.doesNotLicense: a census: the unexamined members are a remainder whose properties are unknown unless a bound names them
SAMPLED.licenses: a declared selection rule drew the examined members from a stated expected population, and the examined members are identified

TRUNCATED_BOUNDED.doesNotLicense: a census, and anything about the omitted members: the bound states how many were not examined, not what they would have shown
TRUNCATED_BOUNDED.licenses: an enumeration stopped at a stated bound or cap; the omitted remainder is counted and the selection rule is recorded

UNKNOWN.doesNotLicense: any count as complete, and any state stronger than itself
UNKNOWN.licenses: the expected population is not stated, or the declaration is too weak to place it, so no completeness claim can be made
